edits.before: - Karma vs Lux - Track: Lux Light Binding. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Light Binding is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.
edits.after: - Karma vs Lux - Track: Lux Light Binding. - Track her engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Light Binding is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.

edits.before: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on his engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.
edits.after: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on her engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.

edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: Light Binding (Q) is a slow single-target skillshot on a 10s cooldown — juke the sightline instead of walking straight, and punish the whiff hard with W root.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: Lucent Singularity (E) denies a zone until she detonates it — eating one Q trade inside costs you the full E-R combo, not a single hit.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep RE shield-speed banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Lux's Light Binding (Q) is a 10s-cooldown single-target root — minion-block it and the E-Q-R combo never starts. - Keep RE shield-speed banked for her best play. - Her R Final Spark is 60/50/40s — punish a missed cast hard.

edits.before: No new ult — press the early lead; scaling supports are waking up behind you.
edits.after: Her E-Q-R poke-and-execute out-ranges you and can burst your ADC before Mantra-E shields it, so Lux spikes at 6.

edits.before: First item: RQ chunks and RE engages — convert to plates and picks now.
edits.after: First-item mage power lets her E-Q-R combo one-shot squishies from range, keeping the lane hers while she lands skillshots.
Lux's passive (Illumination) primes a target after a landed spell — her follow-up auto detonates it, so that auto's wind-up is your real cue to disengage, not the spell cast.
